blocker.details: The Flash score and fixup entry points are local device symbols in embedded cubins. The only exported host function is a ggml_cuda_flash_attn_ext_vec_case wrapper taking ggml_backend_cuda_context and ggml_tensor, with internal tensor strides, scratch buffers, stream policy, and partition/fixup setup. No callable raw Q/K/V/output-buffer ABI exists for tinygrad graph-owned allocations.
blocker.consequence: Cannot stage-isolate or safely launch the requested score+stream-K+fixup pair; no correctness/timing/full-model A/B claim is admissible.
